description: This PHP source file contains utility functions related to the MVC (Model-View-Controller) pattern and AJAX handling within the SuiteCRM platform. It provides functions for loading view classes, generating print links, managing banned modules for AJAX, and wrapping URLs for AJAX requests.

methods.name: loadParentView
methods.description: Loads the appropriate PHP view class file based on the provided view type, checking custom and default include paths.

methods.name: getPrintLink
methods.description: Generates a URL or JavaScript snippet for a print action, adjusting behavior based on whether the request is via AJAX or a regular page load.

methods.name: ajaxBannedModules
methods.description: Returns an array of module names that are restricted from AJAX operations, with optional merging or overriding via global configuration.

methods.name: ajaxLink
methods.description: Wraps a URL for AJAX handling, adding parameters or returning the original URL based on configuration and whether the URL points to a banned module or is a JavaScript call.
